thread:
anya: quick proposal — add a 'support-safe-preview' flow so CS can see scrubbed, context-preserving snippets without access to raw PII. goal: faster debug + minimal privacy surface.

sam: curious — what do you mean by "scrubbed, context-preserving"? a couple of examples would help. :thinking_face:

anya: good call. two modes: (1) redact-high-confidence PII and show surrounding tokens, (2) pseudonymize low-confidence items and append a confidence score. always remove sensitive attachments / base64. show redaction markers like [REDACTED_EMAIL].

khoa: implementation notes: on ingest we already run PII heuristics. we can emit a preview payload derived from the scrubber pipeline, store it in an ephemeral store with TTL=7d, encrypted with KMS key per-tenant. add audit record when preview viewed. keep raw request never surfaced to CS.

ellie: privacy checks: must enforce minimum confidence threshold for any automatic pseudonymization. if confidence < 0.6 we should only show a heavily redacted snippet, and CS must request breakglass (audited). also require tenant opt-in + DPA check for pilot.

maria: from support side — we need enough context to reproduce: previous prompt, model response, and a couple surrounding tokens. a small flag on ticket UI -> "Open safe preview" that logs who clicked it. :+1:

sam: telemetry / quotas thought: previews will increase token access + storage. propose default sampling at 0.5% of support-facing requests cluster-wide, with per-tenant override in console (max 10%). expose metrics: preview_requests, preview_views, preview_denies, preview_storage_bytes.

anya: UX idea: show inline confidence as a subtle badge (e.g., 87%) and a tooltip with what was removed. also add a console heatmap for routes with many previews so PMs can tune redaction rules.

khoa: quick proto of header and example request we can adopt:

```
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
X-Support-Preview: true  # forwarding hint to sampler
Content-Type: application/json

{ "model": "rwx-1", "input": "..." }
```

sam: +1 to header. sampler will check tenant allowlist + sampling quota. implementation detail: mark preview payload with `preview_meta: { scrub_version: v3, confidence: 0.87 }` but we must not persist raw request anywhere in log streams. store only scrubbed snippet and provenance id.

ellie: do not include `preview_meta` in any telemetry that could re-identify. telemetry should be counts and aggregated histograms only. field-level confidence in the UI is fine as long as it never leaks to logs.

ops-bot: runbook created -> https://runbooks.internal/redwood/support-safe-preview (ops: created by @ops-bot)

maria: request: we need an admin toggle in Console: per-tenant preview_enable (on/off), preview_sample_rate, preview_audit_retention_days. also link to the audit CSV export.

sam: cost estimate — previews (scrubbed) add ~0.5% to storage and indexing so we can absorb during pilot. if pilot grows we need a quota plan for Dedicated customers.

anya: rollout plan suggestion: 1) internal pilot (support+security) for 2 weeks, 2) opt-in for 5 trusted tenants, 3) console controls and audit retention defaults to 30d, 4) postmortem and billing evaluation.

khoa: engineering checklist: implement sampler hook, ephemeral store + KMS, console toggles, audit trail, and end-to-end test (privacy e2e). I'll draft the PR and infra changes.

ellie: I'll prepare the privacy impact note and the threshold matrix for redaction vs pseudonymize.

maria: happy to run pilot with ACME and BetaCorp — will prepare support playbook.

anya: sweet — thanks everyone. can we label owners? sam (sam) for sampler + telemetry, khoa for infra, ellie for privacy signoff, maria for pilot ops. I'll track in the RFC. :thumbsup:

sam: ack. I'll add metric names: `support_preview.shown`, `support_preview.denied`, `support_preview.sample_rate` and a dashboard stub.

khoa: throwing one more thought — add a TTL-based scrub-rollup job that deletes previews older than retention and emits deletion audit event.

ellie: must also surface a consent flag for EU tenants. i'll write the consent wording.

maria: FYI — support legal asked we block previews for any tenant with data residency restrictions until opt-in confirmed. noted.

anya: perfect. i'll open the RFC and link infra/console issues. pilot goal: reduce time-to-repro by 30% for ticket category "model-behavior".

sam: :rocket:

maria: :white_check_mark: ready to pilot

ops-bot: created ticket ENG-7834 (support-safe-preview)

anya: closing for now — will post RFC link when ready.
